source.title: Uniform Edge Betweenness Centrality
source.version_of_record: Electron. J. Graph Theory Appl. 8(2) (2020) 265-300, DOI 10.5614/ejgta.2020.8.2.7
source.conjecture: Conjecture 2.1, p. 279 (VoR extract L676-695; arXiv main.tex L969-982, unnumbered)

notes: Definition 1.1 (VoR L52-60): B'(e) = sum over distinct x,y of sigma_xy(e)/sigma_xy; ordered pairs (VoR L66-68 'double-counted'); endpoints included (Lemma 1.1 lower bound 2, VoR L73); no normalization.
Conjecture 2.1 classes and n = 1,2,3,... match the MathDB literal exactly; arXiv v1 and VoR texts identical.
Ordered vs unordered is an exact factor 2, so uniformity is convention-independent (confirmed numerically); the endpoint-excluding variant is also non-uniform.
No source verification of Classes 4/7/8: the appendix covers only vertex-transitive graphs on 12-15 vertices (VoR L790, L1025, L1086, L1344), with Mathematica floats to 6 significant digits.
Dossier errors: the appendix range is 12-15 (not 14-21); the '3-4 digit' floating-point explanation is unsupported at the printed 6-digit precision.

results.multiplier_isomorphisms: 4->7 k=2n+5, 4->8 k=2n+7, 7->8 k=4n+11 for every n<=30 (connection sets pairwise distinct); 4->7 also proved by hand for all n
results.typo_screen: no connected 6-regular C32(1,a,b) (91 graphs) or C40(1,a,b) (153 graphs) is uniform; the m=20,28 controls recover the known uniform graphs

D_significance_exclusion.notes: A genuine exact small counterexample to a refereed, computation-motivated conjecture. Not a source-formula evaluation, wording/typo correction, withdrawn statement or heuristic failure, as far as can be established. Moderate significance: one of four isomorphism-distinct families (4 = 7 = 8) fails.
